{{Top|leg}}
'''Spaceport Security Authority''' was the generic term used to describe the security forces which guarded the largest [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They were most prominent at [[Imperial-class spaceport]]s.
